summary: Verification pass after 3 LOW security-hardening changes to backend/server.py. Backend: 11 pytest tests (root endpoint, docs/redoc/openapi disabled on internal port 8001, removed GET/POST /api/status, CORS without credentials, unknown route 404) all passed. Frontend: full Playwright e2e on public URL - all sections render, cookie consent accept works, nav anchor scroll works, contact form submits with German thank-you alert and resets, back-to-top works, service detail page opens and returns home, all 3 legal pages load. Zero console errors. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: no /api health endpoint beyond root; fine for this static site. CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' via env fallback - acceptable since allow_credentials=False.
Contact form remains frontend-only (alert) with no backend persistence - intentional mock per request, but no client-side validation error states exist for invalid email beyond native HTML5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers hardening assertions: docs disabled must be verified on http://localhost:8001 (external /docs returns SPA 200 by design). /api/status endpoints removed. Frontend is fully static/mock; only route list is /, /service/:service, /impressum, /datenschutz, /agb.
